_comment: Secure Cline MCP server configuration. Deploy to the Cline MCP settings file. All filesystem servers MUST be scoped to specific workspace directories. Never mount '/' or '~'.

filesystem._comment: Read-only filesystem access scoped to workspace only. Replace /path/to/workspace with the actual project directory.

git._comment: Git operations on the workspace repository only. Does not provide shell access.

_disabled_examples._comment: These server configurations are provided as reference but MUST NOT be enabled without security review.

filesystem-unrestricted._reason: Mounts the entire home directory — exposes .ssh/, .aws/, .env files, and all personal data to the AI agent.

shell._reason: Provides unrestricted shell execution to the AI agent. Equivalent to giving the agent a terminal with no restrictions.

browser._reason: Allows the AI to browse arbitrary URLs including internal network addresses. Enables SSRF and data exfiltration via HTTP.

_security_notes: Audit every MCP server's source code before enabling it — npm packages can be compromised.
Pin MCP server package versions (e.g., @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@1.2.3) to prevent supply-chain updates.
Scope filesystem servers to the minimum required directory. Use separate servers for separate projects.
Never pass API keys, tokens, or credentials in the 'env' block — use OS-level environment variables instead.
Review the Cline MCP settings file in source control; secrets accidentally added there will be committed.
Disable MCP servers that are not actively needed. Remove entries rather than commenting them out.
All MCP tool calls appear in Cline's task history — review logs for unintended data exposure.
